source_title: Samsung Black Friday 2026: Ready for a Premium Upgrade? - samsung.com
source_excerpt:
Thinking about a new phone, a bigger TV or replacing your washing machine? Samsung Black Friday 2026 brings The Upgrade Moment: a chance to get more from the technology you use daily, including AI features that help make everyday tasks easier.
Black Friday falls on Friday 27 November 2026. Customers in the UK can visit www.samsung.com/uk/offer/black-friday/ to register for early access to offers starting on Wednesday, 4 November 2026.
Galaxy smartphone offers: Upgrade what’s possible in your pocket
Considering the Galaxy Z Fold8 or the Galaxy S26 this Black Friday? Discover new ways to enjoy your favourite content, capture memories and get things done.
Galaxy Z Fold8 unfolds to give you more space for watching, browsing and reading.
Galaxy S26 brings Galaxy AI to everyday tasks, including Photo Assist, which lets you move, resize or remove objects, or completely transform your images.
Save £250 on Galaxy S26 from 28 October to 17 November 2026 1 .
Black Friday Price Promise. Find it cheaper at selected online retailers from 4 November 2026 to 1 December 2026 and we’ll return the difference 2 .
Galaxy tablet and laptop offers: Upgrade your work and creativity
Explore the Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra, Galaxy Tab S10 FE and Galaxy Book6 Pro this Black Friday for work, study and creativity.
Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra combines AI tools for summarising content and refining writing with Samsung DeX for organising your workspace. Galaxy Tab S10 FE offers practical tools in Samsung Notes, including Handwriting Help 3 to tidy notes and Solve Math 4 to help with calculations.
Prefer working on a laptop? Galaxy Book6 Pro includes AI Select and AI Cut out to turn on-screen images into visuals for presentations, alongside natural-language search to help find files, photos and settings 5 .
Get up to £140 on the Galaxy Tab S12 Series with code BLACK1*, plus get an extra £100 off when you trade in with code S12TI** 6 . Offer available from 4 November 2026.
Get up to £75 off the Galaxy Tab S10 FE Series when you checkout with PayPal 7 . Offer available from 28 October 2026.
Get an extra £200 off when you trade in a Galaxy Book6 Pro with code EXTRATRADE 8 . Offer available from 28 October 2026.
Galaxy earbuds and smartwatch offers: Get more from every day
Discover Galaxy Buds4 Pro, Galaxy Buds4 and Galaxy Watch9 this Black Friday, with features to support your day – from your morning commute to your evening workout.
Galaxy Buds4 Pro combine enhanced Active Noise Cancellation and Adaptive EQ to adapt listening to your surroundings, while Galaxy Buds4 offer an open-fit design for everyday listening.
Galaxy Watch9 provides activity and sleep insights, with an AI-powered Energy Score 9 informed by recent sleep and activity trends.
Save up to £50 on Galaxy Buds4 and Galaxy Buds4 Pro 10 . Offer available from 28 October 2026.
Get £50 off the Galaxy Watch9 with code BFW 11 . Offer available from 28 October 2026.
Samsung TV offers: Upgrade your viewing experience
Considering a Micro RGB TV or The Frame TV this Black Friday? Samsung’s TVs offer different ways to upgrade your enjoyment of films, sport and gaming.
Micro RGB TVs use micro-sized red, green and blue LED backlights, together with AI processing, to refine colour and picture quality.
The Frame combines TV entertainment with Art Mode to display artwork or your own photos when you are not watching.
Claim your VAT back on selected Micro RGB and The Frame TVs, plus get up to £150 off when you recycle your old TV 12 . Offer available from 4 November 2026.
Samsung home appliance offers: Upgrade your everyday routines
Explore Samsung Bespoke AI washing machines and Samsung Bespoke AI refrigerators this Black Friday for help managing everyday tasks.
Bespoke washing machines feature AI Wash+, which senses load weight and soiling to adjust water, detergent and rinsing, and recognises supported fabric types under specified conditions.
Samsung’s Bespoke AI refrigerator features AI Vision Inside, which helps identify supported foods as they enter or leave the fridge, making it easier to keep track of ingredients.
Save up to £500 on Home Appliances*, plus claim your VAT back on selected appliances** 13 . Offer available from 4 November 2026.
Save up to £500 on Fridge Freezers*, plus claim your VAT back on selected appliances** 14 . Offer available from 4 November 2026.
Save up to £150 Washing Machines and Tumble Dryers*, plus claim your VAT back on selected appliances** 15 . Offer available from 4 November 2026.
